hardware.scope: Container-visible hardware only; hostname/CPU identity do not prove physical host separation

fragmentationNote: DF probe: Linux IP_MTU_DISCOVER=IP_PMTUDISC_DO; packet bytes exclude 20-byte IPv4 and 8-byte UDP headers
scope: Authenticated raw IPv4 UDP echo on explicitly bound addresses; low-rate reachability probe, not throughput capacity, clock synchronization, physical-host-separation or HA evidence
providerMachineIdNote: Record provider machineId externally for every node; this probe does not infer it
verdictScope: One initiator's authenticated private-IP request/echo path for each tested packet size; repeat with node roles reversed and a new run ID
